articles.title: Galaxy sets up $5 million fund to help shield Bitcoin against quantum computing threats
articles.snippet: The crypto financial services firm is funding developers to strengthen the blockchain's security before quantum computers become powerful enough to steal billions in crypto.

articles.title: Russia’s parliament passes crypto market law with $3,800 annual cap for retail investors
articles.snippet: While citizens still cannot use Bitcoin to buy groceries, the Kremlin is officially letting companies use digital tokens to bypass sanctions and other global trade hurdles.

articles.title: MoneyGram's CEO says blockchain works best when customers don't know it's there
articles.snippet: In an interview with CoinDesk, MoneyGram CEO Anthony Soohoo said that their blockchain strategy has evolved from early experimentation into a broader effort to modernize the company's global payments infrastructure.

articles.title: Inside Cardano's 'Van Rossum' hard fork, and what it means for users
articles.snippet: The Van Rossem hard fork moved Cardano to version 11 on Saturday. And for the first time, Cardano's community voted in the upgrade, not the company that built it.

articles.title: Exodus to cut 25% of global workforce in payments shift
articles.snippet: This restructuring is part of a strategy to build a full-stack payments platform following the company's acquisitions of Monavate and Baanx.
